_readme: The single source of truth for every market. Edit this, run `node scripts/build-cities.js`, commit the generated <slug>.html files and cities.html. Adding a market is one entry here. Never hand-edit a generated page, the build overwrites it.

cities.name: Lloydminster
cities.headline: Indoor screen advertising in Lloydminster.
cities.intro: 35 screens across 33 venues on both the Alberta and Saskatchewan sides. Cafes, pubs, salons, clinics, gyms and auto shops, in front of the people who already walk past your competitors every day.
cities.metaTitle: Digital Screen Advertising in Lloydminster, AB & SK | Reach Screens
cities.metaDescription: Advertise on 35 indoor digital screens across 33 Lloydminster venues, both the Alberta and Saskatchewan sides. See every location on the map and get your ad on screen.
